name: Source-consistent geospatial asset handoff
artifact_kind: Executable workflow and optional explicit-binding WKT/CSV adapter
attribution: Contains data from Ville de Montréal, provided under Creative Commons Attribution4.0. Transformed and reconciled by this study; no endorsement is implied.
rights_scope: Public municipal source data only. No customer data, secrets, restricted evaluation answers or paid third-party data included.
applicability: Finite vector asset-to-polygon association inside EPSG32188 area of use
Exact normalized identifier and geometric support remain separate
Public-source local research handoff; original source truth is not certified
Named CRS and per-mission field binding required for CSV/WKT adapter
failure_modes: Wrong source facts within geographically plausible bounds can remain undetected
Boundary precision can affect geometric association and must be reviewed
Missing IDs, invalid geometry, ambiguous matches and disagreements remain review obligations
No cadastral, ownership, survey, facility-operation or municipal-approval guarantee
New rights, input meaning, versions and authority must be assessed per mission
expected_reuse: Scenario input only; demand and incremental savings are unmeasured. Retention economics may reject admission.
